# Skill

Generate Test Scenarios

## Purpose

Turn a requirement into a clear test idea.

## Inspect

- User-visible behavior
- Starting page or state
- Test data
- Expected result

## Check

- One main purpose
- Clear precondition
- Repeatable data
- Visible result
- Useful cleanup

## Process

1. Read the requirement.
2. Write the starting state.
3. Write the action and data.
4. Write the expected result.
5. Map the scenario to existing keywords.

## Output

- Scenario name
- Preconditions
- Test data
- Main action
- Expected result
- Open assumptions
